reviews.reason: Checked the full model/restriction definitions against the maximal ODE and local-flow suppliers. The revised chart clause preserves the similarity formula since G(z*)=0 and preserves full orbit intervals by pulling extensions through the inverse. Taking infima proves the displayed distance bounds; the explicit escaping free orbit proves why arbitrary diffeomorphisms require qualification. Model data and SI numerical norms are unchanged.

Checked all six deductions under the exact C2 mechanical-chart hypotheses: energy trapping supplies strict-minimum stability; spectral congruence transfers the negative direction; direct differentiation verifies the growing vector with arbitrary initial deviation; all negative normalized Hessian modes give real nonzero first-order spectrum, and translation to zero licenses the saddle theorem. Continuity plus conservation contradicts attraction from different-energy data. The normalized matrix/vector distinction is now explicit and no empirical or additional choice premise is introduced.

Differentiation and initial values verify the globally defined harmonic motion, so uniqueness makes it complete. The new exact shift/period suppliers give Psi_pi=-id and Psi_2pi=id; the sine zero-set theorem proves the only intervening zero is pi, with negative section velocity. Both crossings have Dh G=vy>0 and the intervening segment avoids the section closure, licensing the first-return supplier. Disjoint U and -U obstruct mixing at every odd iterate, while isometry refutes every positive sensitivity constant.

Checked both globally defined flows by differentiating and evaluating at zero, then applying force-model uniqueness. The harmonic derivative has R^T R=I by the exact Pythagorean supplier, so every nonzero tangent rate is zero and its exponent exists. In repulsive coordinates q+v and q-v, the derivative multiplies by exp(t) and exp(-t); logarithm inversion gives the stated exact rates and complete lifetime gives the limits. Unit conversion and the no-chaos/no-observation scope are retained. Source locators now describe the passages actually consulted.
